card.name: Creatinine clearance and heart block
card.fires_on: The word completing a lab or condition term, mainly "clearance" after creatinine, or "block" after atrioventricular. It appears in dosing and contraindication text.

modes.label: Creatinine clearance
modes.description: "clearance" (or "CLcr") right after creatinine, followed by a mL/min cutoff.
modes.example: Initiation of STRIBILD in patients with estimated creatinine<< clearance>> below 70 mL per minute is

modes.label: Atrioventricular block
modes.description: "block" ending the heart conduction term in a contraindication list.
modes.example: Sinus bradycardia, second or third degree atrioventricular<< block>>, overt cardiac failure, cardiogenic shock

card.writes: It promotes words like "conditions" and "age", which hints at a qualifying clause about patient conditions coming next.
card.plain: It lights up on the last word of terms like creatinine clearance or atrioventricular block, which set the patient limits in drug labels.
